title: Solar cold rooms farmers rent by the day
problem: Small farmers lose part of their harvest because they can't afford cold storage near the farm.
solution: Portable solar-powered cold rooms near villages, booked by the day through a simple phone app.

roles.cs: Booking app and live temperature alerts
roles.mech: Cold room, insulation and cooling unit
roles.biz: Pricing, farmer outreach and seed funding

model.revenue: Daily rent per crate plus a yearly plan

checks.demand: Farmers already sell in a rush at low prices to avoid spoilage.
checks.today: Sell immediately, or let produce spoil.
checks.who: Vegetable and fruit farmers far from cold storage.
checks.wedge: One cold room at one village market, rented per crate.
checks.seen: Talk to 20 farmers at a local mandi about losses.
checks.future: Heat waves and food prices keep raising demand for storage.

title: Vegetable price alerts and group buying for small restaurants
problem: Small restaurants can't plan costs because vegetable prices jump without warning.
solution: An app that alerts owners to price changes and pools nearby orders for bulk discounts.

roles.cs: Price tracking, alerts and ordering app
roles.biz: Supplier deals, restaurant sign-ups and pricing

model.revenue: Monthly subscription plus commission on group orders

checks.demand: Owners call several suppliers daily to compare prices.
checks.today: Phone calls, WhatsApp groups and guesswork.
checks.who: Restaurants with 10–40 seats buying produce daily.
checks.wedge: Price alerts for 10 vegetables in one neighbourhood.
checks.seen: Interview 15 owners about weekly cost swings.
checks.future: More small food businesses open every year.

title: Low-cost EV charging points at neighbourhood shops
problem: Electric scooter owners in smaller towns can't find a place to charge.
solution: Simple charging points at local shops, which earn a share of every charge.

roles.cs: App to find, book and pay for chargers

model.revenue: Per-charge fee split with the shop

checks.demand: EV sales are growing faster than charging in small towns.
checks.today: Charge only at home, which limits distance.
checks.wedge: Five chargers at five shops on one busy road.
checks.seen: Ride along with delivery riders for a day.
checks.future: Government push for EVs keeps growing the market.

title: Rainwater harvesting kits for housing societies
problem: Housing societies buy tanker water in summer while rainwater runs off their roofs.
solution: A ready-to-install harvesting and filter kit with an app that shows water saved.

roles.civil: Roof and tank layout, installation plan

model.revenue: Kit sale plus yearly maintenance plan

checks.demand: Societies spend heavily on tankers every summer.
checks.wedge: One pilot kit in one society with measured savings.
checks.seen: Ask 10 society secretaries about tanker bills.
checks.future: Water rules and shortages are getting stricter.

title: Machine health alerts for small factories
problem: Small factories lose days of work when a machine breaks without warning.
solution: Clip-on vibration and heat sensors that warn owners before a machine fails.

roles.mech: Which machines fail and how, sensor placement

model.revenue: Sensor kit plus monthly monitoring fee

checks.demand: Downtime costs owners orders and wages.
checks.today: Fix machines only after they break.
checks.wedge: Monitor one key machine in three factories.
checks.seen: Visit an industrial estate and log breakdowns.
checks.future: More factories are adopting simple digital tools.

title: WhatsApp tutor in local languages
problem: Students in smaller towns get stuck on homework with no one to ask in their own language.
solution: An AI tutor on WhatsApp that explains lessons step by step in local languages.

roles.cs: AI tutor, WhatsApp bot and lesson content

model.value: Help any time, in their language

checks.demand: Parents already pay for tuition they can barely afford.
checks.today: Expensive tuition, or no help at all.
checks.wedge: Maths help in one language for one class.
checks.seen: Run a free pilot with 30 students.

title: Dust monitors for construction sites
problem: Construction sites face fines and complaints over dust but can't measure it.
solution: Low-cost dust sensors with alerts that switch on water sprinklers automatically.

checks.demand: Pollution rules now fine sites that skip dust control.
checks.wedge: One sensor plus report for one site.
checks.seen: Talk to site engineers about inspections.

title: Drone spraying service for small farms
problem: Farmers struggle to find labour for spraying, and manual spraying wastes chemicals.
solution: A book-by-the-acre drone spraying service run by trained local operators.

roles.mech: Drone frame, tank and nozzle setup

checks.demand: Labour shortages at spraying time are common.
checks.wedge: Spraying in one taluka for one crop season.
checks.seen: Join a spraying day and time the work.
checks.future: Drone rules and subsidies are opening this market.

title: Quick-build shelters for construction workers
problem: Construction workers often live in unsafe, hot temporary sheds.
solution: Modular, heat-reducing shelters that builders set up and move between sites.

checks.demand: Builders must meet new welfare norms for workers.
checks.today: Tin sheds rebuilt at every site.
checks.who: Builders running projects over a year.
checks.wedge: Ten units at one site on rent.
checks.seen: Visit three sites and note living conditions.
checks.future: Worker welfare rules are getting stricter.
